Elena: Short note to coordinate the joint perf/W sweep with NVIDIA + GCP. Aim: reproducible public numbers + detailed partner appendix.
Ravi: Core metrics: tokens/sec, board+host W, tokens/J, p50/p95 latency. Keep sample window >= 5 minutes for steady-state.
NVIDIA Eng: We'll run H100S and provide NVML traces (250ms). Please include AMI/container and exact env vars.
Google Cloud BD: We'll surface marketplace/badging needs. Legal wants conservative phrasing and 10 business days for review after numbers freeze.
Elena: Bench matrix (trimmed): models=[Llama-2-13B], quant=[fp16,int8], seq=[8k], batch=[1,16,32], plus a 5-min chat replay app-sim.
Ravi: Run snippet we use:
```bash
./rdb_bench --model $1 --len $2 --batch $3 --quant $4 --warmup 50 --steps 600 --measure-power --power-ms 250
```
NVIDIA Eng: For kernel tuning try hugepages=1024, iommu=pt, irqbalance=off. We'll test a fused-kernel micro-op tweak and report percent delta.
Elena: Action items: @NVIDIA Eng -> kernel patch PR by Wed; @Ravi -> scripts + parser by Tue; @Google Cloud BD -> legal kickoff. Benchmark Bot: queued job bench-1755200000 on perf-node-2.
Benchmark Bot: Job bench-1755200000 submitted, est runtime 6h, status: pending. :gear:
Ravi: I'll attach a small README to reproduce tokens/J from CSVs. Repro must include driver/kernel commits.
Elena: Great. Sync Thurs 9am PT to review preliminary numbers. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
